Metadata.title: IMMERSE
Metadata.description: Learn a language through the videos you love.

Landing.heroEyebrow: Learn a language from videos you choose
Landing.heroTitle: Turn your favorite videos into your language teacher.
Landing.heroDescription: Learn from scenes you already love watching. Save words, understand sentences, and use them in real life.
Landing.examplePhrase: A little goes a long way.
Landing.featuresDescription: Learn from videos you actually want to watch.

benefits.title: Language in context
benefits.text: Hear words in the moments people actually say them.

benefits.title: Words that stick
benefits.text: Save new expressions and revisit them when you're ready to learn.

benefits.title: Practice at your pace
benefits.text: Use flashcards to remember without rushing.

benefits.title: The story is still yours
benefits.text: You're learning, but the story stays part of your downtime.

Landing.stepsDescription: Learning a language shouldn't feel like doing homework.

steps.title: Choose a video
steps.text: Start with a video that sparks your curiosity.

steps.title: Follow the words
steps.text: Read the transcript and save new words.

steps.title: Review for a moment
steps.text: Practice again with flashcards and your own progress.

Landing.mascotEyebrow: A study buddy, not a robot
Landing.mascotDescription: A curious cat with a backwards blue cap, a favorite hoodie, and a yellow backpack. Mersi is with you from start to finish—and ready to help whenever you get stuck.
Landing.finalTitle: Ready to learn from stories you love?
Landing.mascotAlt: Mersi, an orange cat mascot wearing a backwards blue cap and blue hoodie
Landing.runningAlt: Mersi running along with your learning journey
Landing.footerTagline: Stories you love make a language feel closer.
Landing.finalDescription: Start with your favorite short video. Mersi is ready to guide you from your very first word.
